content: Glean: workplace search + assistant. Traces each statement to its source document during generation, so a synthesized answer shows which claim came from the legal brief vs the support playbook - per-claim attribution, not per-answer. Builds an enterprise knowledge graph mapping people/content/interactions, used mainly for personalization ranking (role, projects, collaborators, shared docs, trending on team). 100+ native connectors, each ingesting content + activity + identity. All answers permissions-aware and referenceable. Third-generation assistant announced with a new Enterprise Graph. Takeaway: per-claim (not per-answer) attribution is the enterprise bar; the graph is a ranking input, not a user-facing canvas.
